scope: Sweep allocations in a rooted generated AC1027 DXF OBJECTS callback containing one named DICTIONARY and one typed SCALE record.

source.profile: The generated NOD contains ACAD_SCALELIST -> DICTIONARY E000 -> SCALE E001 (name 1:1, units 1/1).

implementation.method: Warm the writer, calibrate callback allocations per encoding, inject one std::bad_alloc at each offset, require failed publication and byte-for-byte destination sentinel preservation, compare caller dictionary/SCALE state, then retry the same dxfRW instance and typed-import the rooted graph.

validation.ascii: 12/12 reached callback allocation offsets injected; destination and caller graph preserved; same-writer retry and typed readback passed.
validation.binary: 12/12 reached callback allocation offsets injected; destination and caller graph preserved; same-writer retry and typed readback passed.

limitations: Generated writer/transaction evidence only; no physical producer prevalence or native semantics are established.
The control covers the typed SCALE writer and rooted dictionary callback, not DXF-origin raw SCALE replay, all adapter source profiles, or other OBJECTS builders.
nextAction: Continue the receipt-driven P6 OBJECTS audit with the next independent builder that lacks an allocation rollback/retry receipt.
